column1: # A Revit 2018 export of Autodesk's rac_basic_sample_project: rac_basic_sample_project.ifc, attached by a
# user to the discussion of the IFC for Revit wiki's "Exporting Zones" page (SourceForge `ifcexporter`,
# 2018-01-04), beside the .rvt it was made from. Its header names exporter 17.4.0.0 for Revit 2018, IFC4
# and `ViewDefinition [ReferenceView_V1.0]`; it holds 17 `IfcSpace`, 14 rooms and 3 MEP Spaces. Its
# provenance is a forum user's, not Autodesk's, and it carries no licence, so it is fetched for a
# measurement run by tools/ci/fetch-rac-basic-2018-export.sh, pinned by sha256 and byte count, and never
# committed, stored or cached. tools/ci/measure-reference-models.sh pairs the 2018 save's rooms with it by
# GlobalId and keeps only the counts (tools/re/spaces_by_globalid_vs_ifc.py without `--list`).
